title: NASA Science
explanation:
# NASA APOD Rewrite

One dedicated astrophotographer spent over 800 hours traversing the dark skies of Eastern China and Inner Mongolia to capture all 313 glowing nebulas in the famous Sharpless Catalog—colorful cosmic clouds of gas where stars are born, die, or shimmer as planetary remnants. Using specialized filters to isolate light from ionized hydrogen and oxygen, he created a stunning collection that includes iconic nebulas like the Eagle, Heart, and Orion, alongside oddly-named treasures like the Medusa and Spaghetti nebulas.
